name: @dexterm/custom
description: dexterm customization layer (task-1358, from the task-1288 design): versioned config.json (no secrets, ever), the layout solver + named workspaces, user themes, keymap overrides, the rules engine (parsed, never eval'd; alerts + PROPOSALS only), shareable packs (hash lock + ssh signature; never executes pack code) and the popup widget API. Zero runtime dependencies.
author: The dexterm authors
